tasks.label: Verify Android Kotlin compilation
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME=/tmp/build-tools/jdk17 ANDROID_HOME=/tmp/android-sdk ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/tmp/android-sdk; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:/tmp/build-tools/gradle-8.2/bin:$PATH"; cd android/ImperialReader && gradle :app:compileDebugKotlin --offline --no-daemon --max-workers=1 -Dkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process
